model: Default ViennaRNA Turner parameter set at 37 C
method: Comparative RNAalifold MFE and partition-function/base-pair-probability analysis
constraint_policy: Unconstrained prediction; Rfam SS_cons used only for post hoc comparison
representative_selection: Deterministic greedy identity representatives from src.metrics.greedy_identity_representatives; lexicographic order and 50% minimum overlap
ambiguity_policy: IUPAC symbols other than A/C/G/U are converted to N only in ViennaRNA input; source Stockholm alignments are not modified.
interpretation_limits: RNAalifold predicts nested secondary structures and does not model WUSS pseudoknots.
No GSC weighting is applied; full and identity-reduced subsets are reported separately.
RNAalifold covariance scoring is not independent of sequence covariation and is not a substitute for R-scape.
Predicted structures and SCI are computational support, not experimental validation.
